text:
Maria: FYI we rolled an fp8 profile to 3% of /v1/translate-zh and saw transl_quality drop 0.015 on the live holdout. No infra errors.

Lee: before rollback we should root cause. could be profile trained on different tokenizer, or lowbit-induced kv-cache churn.

Sam: can we get per-profile stats? might be one bad profile misattached to a slot.

Maria: looks like profile-zh-2026-03b is implicated; higher repetition and token misalignment noted in traces.

Nora: propose a safety_score per profile: weighted combo of degscore, latency regression, token_alignment. if safety_score < threshold -> trigger soft-fallback.

Devon: ops needs concrete knobs. suggestion:
quant_profile_safety: eval_interval_minutes: 360, safety_weights: {degscore:0.6, latency:0.25, token_align:0.15}, safety_threshold:0.85, soft_fallback_pct:90, retain_probe_pct:10, min_hits_before_eval:500

Anya (QA): QA can run automated live-playback comparing last 10k requests against fallback and profile and produce a diff heatmap whenever safety_score crosses threshold.

Sam: API ideas: GET /profiles/:id/safety -> (safety_score, last_eval_ts, recent_delta_pct, quarantined_until), POST /profiles/:id/override for per-customer opt-outs.

Lee: also need quarantine_anchor timestamp to prevent immediate reuse; require min_quarantine_before_reuse. add hysteresis so profiles don't flip-flop during rollouts.

Maria: tradeoff note: strict thresholds protect quality but reduce cost wins. allow endpoint-level sensitivity overrides (e.g., translation vs summarization).

Nora: telemetry must emit: profile_safety_score, profile_shadow_success_rate, profile_fallback_rate, profile_playback_delta. Dashboards + alert rules: page if profile_fallback_rate > 2% in 1h for prod.

Devon: when many profiles fallback at once (cascade) throttle fallback traffic to avoid saturating higher-bit pools. ops-bot: create ticket for cascade throttling.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-5678 created: "Profile safety_score, per-endpoint sensitivity, API + auto-fallback playbook". Assignee: Lee. Priority: P1.

Lee: I'll draft an RFC covering safety_score calc, API contract, quarantine semantics, cascade throttle, and release playbook.

Anya (QA): I'll prototype the playback job and run it against profile-zh-2026-03b; will post diff charts here.

Maria: temporary mitigation: roll profile-zh-2026-03b back to shadow-only and keep monitoring. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
